picks.name: Afriqua
picks.source_note: Already in your library. New label discovery: Nervous Records.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Bottled Up" (September 24, 2026, Nervous Records) is a fresh single with accompanying dub versions, continuing Afriqua's boundary-defying approach to dancefloor music.
picks.why_listen: A dependable, genre-roaming producer dropping a new one on a storied house label -- solid, flexible groove material.

picks.name: Yazmin Lacey
picks.source_note: New artist discovery, remixed by Karen Nyame KG. Club-leaning UK funky/Afro-electronica territory.
picks.bio: "Sweetest Season (Karen Nyame KG Remix)" (September 9, 2026) takes Yazmin Lacey's Femi Koleoso-produced summer single and reworks it through KG's African-polyrhythm-driven, club-ready lens.
picks.why_listen: A soulful vocal cut transformed into a percussive, Afro-infused club remix -- useful for bridging soul/vocal and dancefloor moments.
